entities.summary: Dana Tyrell is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre who played five seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL), primarily for the Tampa Bay Lightning. He was selected in the second round by the Lightning in the 2007 NHL entry draft. He also played for the Columbus Blue Jackets.
